ohio.line: Would you look at Miss Ohio?
stanza: Oh me oh my oh
Would you look at Miss Ohio?
She’s a-running around with the ragtop down
She says "I wanna do right, but not right now"

ohio.line: I ask where she's headed, she tells me, "Ohio:
stanza: Out from my window across from the city
I have what's considered a good view
Two blocks from the subway, three from the fountain
Where I walk to break in new shoes
She stands on the sidewalk just waving at taxis
Like horses in parades in passing
I ask where she's headed, she tells me, "Ohio:
I've not seen my mother in ages"

ohio.line: Than when I was a boy in Ohio
stanza: It was 3.2 beer at the honky tonk bar

ohio.line: Buy a vase of carnations from central Ohio
stanza: Guard my bed
While the rain turns the ditches to mirrors

ohio.line: She belong to her mother & the state of Ohio
stanza: Out from my window please hear me Ohio
Your daughter wants to come home
She longs to be with you
To hug you to kiss you
To never leave her alone
I've gotten to know her to live with to love her
It's hard to see her leave
She belong to her mother & the state of Ohio
